citations: Dates: the Gregorian calendar governs UAE commercial contracts; Hijri is not required on a facility offer letter (confirm with the institution's counsel).

Supervision depends on the licence: a CBUAE-licensed bank or finance company is bound by CBUAE rules; a government development fund may sit outside them. Recorded per tenant as licenceType at onboarding.

Residency of customer data in the UAE: production data held in the UAE behind a customer-managed HSM (ADR 0005, constraint deployment_profile_production_residency). The governing UAE requirement is to be confirmed with counsel (ADR 0005, open items). Saudi residency rules do not apply.
